description: Open a connection to a BrAPI v2 server, authenticate, and return the full orientation envelope (server identity, capability profile, content summary, suggested next tools). Required handshake before other BrAPI tools. Supports multiple concurrent connections via named aliases. Credentials can be configured server-side and omitted from this call. When a request carries no MCP session on a deployment without per-user auth, aliases live in one namespace shared by every such caller: re-registering an alias re-points their later calls to it. Built-in known servers (callable with no `baseUrl` or `auth` — public BrAPI v2 endpoints): `bti-breedbase-demo`, `bti-cassava`, `bti-sweetpotato`. Aliases are shortcuts only; any other BrAPI v2 server is reachable by passing `baseUrl` directly.

alias.description: Alias for this connection. Use distinct aliases to register multiple BrAPI servers in one session.

auth.description: Auth payload. Omit to use credentials configured server-side for this alias (or no auth when none are configured).

oneOf.description: Bearer-token variant — caller already has an access token.

token.description: Pre-obtained access token, sent verbatim with each BrAPI request.

oneOf.description: API-key variant — static key sent in a configurable header.

apiKey.description: API key issued by the BrAPI server.

headerName.description: HTTP header to send the API key in. Defaults to `Authorization`.

mode.description: Static API key in a custom header.

oneOf.description: SGN variant — username/password exchanged at /token for a session bearer.

mode.description: Breedbase/SGN username+password; exchanged for a bearer token at /token.

password.description: Password for the SGN/Breedbase username supplied above.

clientId.description: OAuth2 client identifier registered with the upstream IdP.

clientSecret.description: OAuth2 client secret paired with the clientId.

mode.description: OAuth2 client-credentials flow; exchanged for an access token at connect time.

tokenUrl.description: OAuth2 token endpoint (absolute URL). Defaults derived from the base URL when omitted.

baseUrl.description: BrAPI v2 base URL (absolute URL) including any path prefix — e.g. https://test-server.brapi.org/brapi/v2. Omit to use the configured default for this alias.

name: brapi_connect

attribution.description: Attribution metadata for built-in known-server connections. Absent for custom (env-only) connections.

citation.description: Citation requested by the upstream when data is reused in publications.

homepage.description: Public homepage of the upstream dataset.

isDemo.description: True when this server hosts demo / sample data, not production records.

license.description: License under which the upstream dataset is published (e.g. "CC-BY").

auth.description: Auth summary for the active connection.

mode.description: Auth mode of the active connection.

baseUrl.description: BrAPI v2 base URL for this connection.

notableGaps.description: Common-floor services this server does NOT expose.

items.description: Common-floor service the server does not expose.

supported.description: Sorted list of supported service names.

supportedCount.description: Total distinct services the server advertises in /calls.

items.description: Common crop name as returned by /commoncropnames.

germplasmCount.description: Total germplasm hosted, when the server exposes a cheap count.

locationCount.description: Total locations hosted, when the server exposes a cheap count.

programCount.description: Total programs hosted, when the server exposes a cheap count.

studyCount.description: Total studies hosted, when the server exposes a cheap count.

dialect.description: Active dialect adapter — translates outbound filters and declares known-dead routes for this server.

disabledSearchEndpoints.description: POST /search nouns the active dialect treats as known-dead. Tools using these routes will refuse with a recovery hint.

items.description: A POST /search/{noun} route the dialect routes around.

envVar.description: Env var that pins the dialect for this alias (e.g. BRAPI_DEFAULT_DIALECT) when detection misfires.

id.description: Active dialect id (e.g. "spec", "cassavabase"). Names a registered adapter that translates outbound filters and declares known-dead routes.

inferredMappingCount.description: Number of filter translations inferred from naming conventions but not independently verified. A non-zero count means some result narrowing on this server may not fire as expected.

notes.description: Dialect-level compatibility notes for this server family.

items.description: Verified compatibility note exposed by the active dialect.

source.description: Where the dialect id came from: env-var override, URL host match, /serverinfo serverName, organizationName, or the spec passthrough fallback.

verifiedMappingCount.description: Number of filter translations the dialect has empirically verified against a live server. Higher means more confidence in the translation table.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `auth_session_required`: Caller-supplied credentials on an HTTP deployment without per-user auth, from a request that carries no MCP session. `auth_base_url_mismatch`: The alias has server-configured credentials and the supplied baseUrl differs from the server configured for it. `alias_base_url_unset`: The alias has server-configured credentials but no base URL of its own (no BRAPI_<ALIAS>_BASE_URL and no enabled built-in), so they pair with no server. `auth_token_exchange_failed`: SGN or OAuth token exchange against the BrAPI /token endpoint failed. `auth_no_access_token`: Token endpoint responded but did not return an access_token. `upstream_unauthorized`: The server answered HTTP 401 on /serverinfo or /calls — it requires login for capability discovery. `upstream_forbidden`: The server answered HTTP 403 on /serverinfo or /calls — the request (anonymous or credentialed) lacks read access. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

fetchedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this envelope was composed.

nextToolSuggestions.description: Entry-point finders (studies, germplasm, variables, locations — in that order) whose GET or POST /search route this server exposes under the active dialect. Empty when none apply.

items.description: A finder the connected server supports, with the arguments to start it.

args.description: Arguments to call the tool with. Alias only — narrow further with the tool filters.

alias.description: Connection alias to pass to the suggested tool.

reason.description: Why this tool applies to the connected server.

toolName.description: Entry-point finder tool this server can serve.

brapiVersion.description: Highest BrAPI version the server reports.
